name: Wash Brush
blurb: Active:  Hwei exits his current mood without incurring its ability cost or cooldown.

effects.description: Toggle - QR, WR, ER: Hwei exits his current mood without incurring its ability cost or cooldown, toggling it off.
Wash Brush can only be cast if Hwei has entered a mood, and can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

notes: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as  Spellblade and triggering  Force Pulse's passive.
